prediction_text: The sick man will die of this sickness; it is not curable. His disease is a fixed, melancholic obstruction — a cold, earthy melancholy settling in the body (spleen/bowel region), wasting and stopping him: a quartan-like, lingering-but-mortal distemper ending in death.
timing: Month scale, in fixed signs (slow but certain): death within the current course of the disease, reckoned in weeks to a few months, not a recovery after long treatment.
basis: Lilly death testimonies concur: the Ascendant is most afflicted by the corporal presence of a planet who is partly lord of the 8th (death's significator in the house of life); the sign of the 6th is fixed and afflicted and the lord of the 6th is in a fixed, earthly, melancholy sign (disease fixed, melancholic, incurable in kind); the Sun, temporal light, is in perfect opposition of Saturn, lord of the 6th, in fixed signs; the Moon is near the Dragon's Tail and afflicted in the Ascendant. Every testimony is to death and none to recovery — direction negative at full grade (rule (b): testimonies are at full strength, no abatement).
